chapter: Opening talk: pianists and Buddy Petit
title: Working with Buddy Petit in 1921, his band and ragtime
summary: Williams played about eight months with Buddy Petit after returning from Los Angeles, before joining Sam Morgan; he lists Petit's men and says ragtime became jazz with the same beat.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Yeah, he was at Pete Lowndes at one time, you know. Yeah, he was at Pete Lowndes. Yeah, he was at Pete Lowndes, too. Did you ever work with Buddy Petitia? Oh, yeah. I worked with Buddy Petitia about two years. When was that? That must have been around, no, it couldn't have been two years. I worked with Buddy Petitia. In 21, when I came back from Los Angeles in 1921. Must have been about eight months, then I joined Sam Morgan's band, you see. Of course, I worked with Sam from 21 to 25, you see. Who was in Buddy's band?
I don't remember. I've been writing just now.

What kind of tunes did they play? Well, they called it that time Ragtime, you know. Ragtime, then they changed the name to jazz. They brought the same kind of a beat as far as the new bands of present girls. Oh, yeah.

Yeah, the same beat. And they played more than Scott Joplin numbers, you know. See, they played a lot of them. But he wasn't a reading musician, you know. Yeah. Just a routine, as we call it, trumpet player, you know. But he was good, very good. I can't think of who he had in this band. I know he had Simon Marrera at one time playing with him.
He had a lot of different people. He had Zeb and Fred Monroe.
Oh, yeah. Zeb. Yeah, that's right. He had a bunch, you know. See. Pills with him on the line. Yeah, yeah. Buddy Man of Day was with him. Oh, yeah. George Washington.
That's right. Little George Washington. He had a thing. He changed him so fast. Because Buddy was, wasn't reliable, you know.
He's been a little. Were you in the band before Faiso or after Faiso?
Must've been after Faiso. Must've been after Faiso. Faiso left here way early twenties. What become of him? I don't know.
I don't know where he is. Never did hear either. No. I think I haven't thought to ask anybody really what's happening. No, no.
I ask a lot of people when I come back. They say they didn't have heard from him. Last time they heard, I believe it was around in Texas somewhere. Galveston or San Antone or somewhere.
